title: Talking Portrait
buildableVersion: A screen or web app that listens, responds in character, and reacts using voice or camera input.
safeDemoMoment: A visitor asks the portrait for advice and receives an overdramatic response.

title: Wand Interface
buildableVersion: A gesture-controlled physical wand that triggers actions such as changing slides, switching lights, or controlling a web app.
safeDemoMoment: A participant performs a spell gesture and the room responds.

title: Web-Slinger Prop
buildableVersion: A completely non-hazardous wrist prop that uses lights, sound, or haptics instead of real projectiles.
safeDemoMoment: A wrist gesture triggers a web animation, sound cue, or harmless light effect.

title: Personal AI Sidekick
buildableVersion: A voice or chat assistant that performs small theatrical tasks, narrates actions, or triggers simple web automations.
safeDemoMoment: The AI gives the team a theatrical mission briefing and triggers one harmless automation.
